## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Tracking

Link relevant issues. Use `Closes #...` only for fully satisfied acceptance criteria.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] Lint: `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Build: `cargo build --workspace --release --locked`
- [ ] Tests: `cargo test --workspace --locked`

List additional checks and any checks not run, including the reason.

## Limitations

Document unfinished behavior, compatibility gaps, and follow-up work.
